# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Chats. "members" = the OTHER people (1 = direct chat, 2+ = group).
# Message syntax:   [optional timestamp] id: text
# Timestamp forms:  [2026-10-20 09:15]  or  [09:15] (same day as previous)
# Without a timestamp, previous time + random 30s..5min is used.
# Attachments:      id: <image:path/to/file.jpg> optional caption
#                   id: <video:path/to/file.mp4>
#                   id: <audio:path/to/file.mp3>
# Missing files still render a placeholder.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
[chat]
members = maya
start = 2026-10-20 09:15
last_seen = online
